baseline_limitations: This is a one-time baseline requested for 2026-09-25; values are the prices exposed by official localized pages retrieved in this run. Where an official page did not expose a numeric localized price, the row is omitted rather than inferred.
Research date requested: 2026-09-25. The accessible official Apple US pages did not expose current numeric prices in the scrape, so no US rows are reported rather than inferred.

The accessible official YouTube Premium pages for US, Canada, and Mexico returned USD-denominated figures ($15.99 monthly, $26.99 family, $8.99 student) regardless of locale parameters; they could not be treated as localized country pricing, so no YouTube rows are reported.

No directly accessible official localized numeric pages were found for the requested Canada/Mexico Apple TV+ and Apple Arcade tiers, or Mexico Apple Music tiers, so those are omitted rather than inferred.
Research date requested: 2026-09-25. The system date is earlier than that date, so future pricing cannot be verified as-of 2026-09-25.

Official localized Apple One pages for Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Sweden and Norway were retrieved, but their rendered price values were not exposed in the accessible page text during this run; no prices were recorded rather than inferred.

Official localized YouTube Premium checkout/pricing pages do not expose stable prices in the accessible official help pages without an account/location-specific checkout; no YouTube rows were recorded.

UK Apple Music/TV/Arcade and Apple One rows are directly cited to official Apple UK pages. Student Apple Music pricing was not clearly advertised with a numeric amount on the accessible official page, so it is omitted.

YouTube Premium pages for all seven assigned countries were accessible only in a generic US-dollar rendering during this research (the official pages displayed $15.99 individual, $26.99 family and $8.99 student/Lite rather than localized country currency); therefore no YouTube rows are included.

The official Apple localized Apple One pages for Switzerland (https://www.apple.com/ch/apple-one/) and Belgium (https://www.apple.com/be/apple-one/) did not expose readable localized prices in the retrieved page, so no rows are included for those countries.
The official Apple Turkey Apple One URL (https://www.apple.com/tr/apple-one/) returned a page-not-found response; no Turkey Apple rows are included.

The retrieved Apple One pages clearly advertised bundle and component monthly prices, but did not clearly advertise student or family standalone Apple Music prices; those tiers are not invented or included.

As of 2026-09-25, official YouTube Premium pages for BR, AR, CO, CL and PE were not accessible with country-localized prices; the pages returned generic/USD or another-market price display, so no YouTube rows are included.

No accessible official Apple localized pricing page was found for Argentina covering the requested Apple subscription tiers; only Apple TV Argentina was accessible and advertised US$6.99/month: https://tv.apple.com/ar.
No accessible official Apple localized pricing page was found for Peru covering the requested Apple subscription tiers.
Apple TV+ and Apple Arcade rows for Brazil, Colombia and Chile are component prices displayed in the official Apple One pages; standalone pages were not separately used where unavailable.

Official YouTube Premium localized checkout pages did not expose reliably extractable country-currency prices in the accessible web results (the generic page returned US-dollar prices), so no YouTube rows are included rather than inferred.

South Korea: accessible official Apple search results confirmed Apple One Individual at ₩14,900/month, but the current localized Apple page did not expose a complete clearly priced tier list in accessible content; omitted to avoid unsupported rows.
Apple TV+ standalone prices were not clearly exposed on the accessible localized Apple pages for these countries, so omitted.
Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam Apple pages accessible in search exposed only the listed tiers/prices; unadvertised tiers are omitted.
Research date requested: 2026-09-25. Official localized pages were accessible for Apple Music in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, yielding the rows above.

No clearly advertised, directly price-supported official localized subscription rows were found for Nigeria, South Africa, or Egypt during this research pass; Apple pages located for those markets did not expose usable tier prices.

Apple One localized pages for Saudi Arabia and the UAE were accessible but did not expose plan prices in the scraped page content; therefore no Apple One rows are invented. Apple TV+ and Apple Arcade localized pages likewise did not expose clearly advertised prices in accessible official content.

No country-specific official YouTube Premium or YouTube Music Premium pricing page with localized currency and tier prices was accessible. The accessible YouTube Premium result was generic/US-dollar content, so no YouTube rows are reported.

YouTube pricing was not reliably localized in the accessible official pages for countries other than the US; country-specific YouTube rows therefore remain unreported and should be populated by authenticated/storefront-aware daily scraping.

Apple standalone service coverage varies by market and page: only tiers with an explicit price on an official localized Apple page were included. Apple TV+, Apple Arcade, Apple One, and Apple Music may have additional tiers or annual options not exposed in the retrieved page text.

run_schedule.weekly_production_schedule: Run once daily at 02:00 UTC; production monitoring/report generation after successful collection. Although this 5-day window is not a full week, retain the daily cadence and resume the following Monday-Friday cadence.

stores: Apple localized web storefronts and App Store subscription displays
Google Play subscription pages where Android price differs, stored separately

historical_backfill.window: Backfill at least 90 days when page/version history or archived snapshots are available; otherwise record null and do not infer

implementation_notes: Use official localized URLs first, with country/locale parameters and explicit storefront context; never substitute a generic USD page for a localized price.
Capture rendered DOM and structured metadata plus screenshot/HTML hash; retain exact source URL, retrieval timestamp, locale, device, and logged-in state.
For YouTube, use a storefront-aware session or official checkout flow because public pages may display generic US prices; do not treat trial text as the recurring price.
Normalize decimal separators and currencies without converting away the original local amount; store tax inclusion and billing period exactly as shown.
Detect and record annual, student, family, individual, premium-lite, and bundle tiers separately; do not collapse Apple One components into standalone subscriptions.
Run retries with backoff, alert on 401/CAPTCHA/locale mismatch, and send rows with missing prices to a review queue rather than estimating.
Compare each daily capture with the 2026-09-25 baseline and previous day; emit alerts for any price, currency, tier, or availability change.

message: Baseline compiled from official localized Apple pages and the official YouTube Premium page. Rows are limited to prices directly exposed in this run; omitted country/service prices are documented in scope.baseline_limitations, with a daily storefront-aware scraper specification for 2026-09-26 through 2026-09-30 UTC.
